pages.text: $(o)Second entry.$()$(br2)Beyond the shrines stands the Observatory, where we once read the stars. It is rarer and larger: seek a ruin of tuff columns open to the sky, in the same lands as the shrines, but much farther apart.

pages.title: The Observatory Gate
pages.text: Two tuff towers and the Order's star above the door.

Be careful. At the heart of the Observatory, in the arena beneath its broken dome, something still stands guard. It did not fall with the Order.$(br2)Go prepared: armour, food, and companions if you have them. If you must flee, it will not follow you beyond its walls.
